Subject: Post-demo: procurement & vendor setup (next steps)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — appreciated the thoughtful questions from your procurement and platform teams. Quick recap and a few asks so we can get Redwood set up as an approved vendor: 

Summary from call:
- Stellar wants predictable costing and the ability to route requests to a dedicated pool for production usage.
- Primary procurement preferred path: PO with Net-30, but team said card-for-one-off is acceptable while vendor enrollment is pending.
- Marketplace listing is desirable if it shortens the purchase flow.

What we need from you to get the vendor created on your side:
1) Your vendor onboarding packet (we can fill what you provide).
2) Confirmation on whether you need a vendor portal invite (we can initiate) or prefer email packet.
3) Any specific banking format (ACH vs wire) and recipient name for the account.

We will prepare our W-9 and the Redwood vendor packet (banking letter + vendor details) and send them over by end of day tomorrow.

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm preferred onboarding channel (portal vs email) and whether PO or card is required for the initial pilot.
- Us: send W-9 + vendor packet and a DocuSign link for signature if that helps speed things up.
- Marcus/Monica (cc'd): will own the vendor packet and respond on payment terms.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the recap — helpful. Quick answers from procurement: 
- Preferred path: PO with Net-30 is standard for anything > $10k. For smaller initial pilots we can process on corporate card to avoid delays.
- Vendor portal: we prefer to use our vendor portal for enrollment (procurement@stellarsystems.com will create the record). If you send the completed packet via DocuSign, we can attach the signed docs to the portal.
- Banking details: ACH preferred; we need routing + account number and a bank letter on company letterhead for verification.

Requested items from Redwood to open the vendor record:
1) Completed vendor setup packet (we will use your packet fields if you have a standard).
2) W-9 (for US tax purposes).
3) Bank verification letter (or voided check) for ACH.

Timeline: if we receive everything by end of week (Feb 12), procurement will aim to issue a PO the following week. If you'd like to pursue marketplace listing (we run AWS and Azure catalogs), I can loop in our platform procurement lead to evaluate.

Tom Hsu (cc) will own the portal onboarding; Tom, please confirm whether we need vendor NAICS codes from Redwood.

Thanks,
Elena
Sr. Procurement Manager
Stellar Systems
elena.rojo@stellarsystems.com
